people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
translations.bsb: Then David reviewed his troops and appointed over them commanders of thousands and of hundreds.
translations.kjv: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
translations.asv: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
